units.source_text: 玉鬘身穿淡墨色丧服，容姿清减。

en.t: Tamakazura wore pale ink colored mourning clothes, and her figure looked slender and subdued.

units.source_text: 但因服色与平常不同，相貌反而更增艳丽，越发引人注目了。

en.t: But because the color of her clothing was different from usual, her beauty seemed all the more vivid and drew even more attention.

units.source_text: 众侍女看了她，个个笑逐颜开。

en.t: When the waiting women saw her, every one of them broke into delighted smiles.

units.source_text: 此时夕雾中将来访。

en.t: Just then Lieutenant General Yugiri came to visit.

units.source_text: 他也穿丧服，是一件墨色较深的常礼服，冠缨卷起，相貌也反而更清秀了。

en.t: He too was in mourning, wearing a formal everyday robe of a deeper ink color, with the cords of his cap rolled up, and this made his face look even clearer and more refined.

units.source_text: 以前，夕雾一向以为玉鬘是姐姐，所以真心地敬爱她；

en.t: In the past, Yugiri had always believed that Tamakazura was his elder sister, and so he had sincerely respected and loved her.

units.source_text: 玉鬘对他也并不疏远回避，习以为常。

en.t: Tamakazura, for her part, had not kept him at a distance or avoided him, taking their closeness as natural.

units.source_text: 如果现在因为知道了不是姐弟而突然改变态度，似乎太不自然。

en.t: If she were suddenly to change her manner now because they had learned they were not siblings, it would seem far too unnatural.

units.source_text: 因此照旧在帘前添设帷屏，隔帘对晤。

en.t: So, as before, an extra screen was set before the blinds, and they met with the curtain between them.

units.source_text: 不用侍女传言，直接交谈。

en.t: They spoke directly, without having the waiting women relay their words.

units.source_text: 夕雾是源氏太政大臣派来的，叫他把皇上的话照样传达给玉鬘。

en.t: Yugiri had been sent by Genji, the Grand Minister, and was told to convey the Emperor's words to Tamakazura exactly as they were.

units.source_text: 玉鬘的答辞落落大方，态度非常得体，贤惠而又高雅。

en.t: Tamakazura's reply was composed and gracious, her manner perfectly appropriate, wise, and elegant.

units.source_text: 夕雾在大风那天早上窥见了她的容姿，心中一直恋恋不忘，只可惜是姐弟关系。

en.t: Yugiri had caught sight of her beauty on the morning of the great wind and had never been able to forget it, though he had lamented that they were brother and sister.

units.source_text: 自从知道实情以后，恋慕之心越发难于抑制了。

en.t: Since learning the truth, his longing for her had become even harder to restrain.

units.source_text: 他推想玉鬘入宫以后，皇上决不会把她看作寻常的女官，皇上和她确是一对天然佳偶。

en.t: He imagined that once Tamakazura entered the palace, the Emperor would never regard her as an ordinary court lady, for the Emperor and she were truly a naturally matched pair.

units.source_text: 但烦恼之事也会突然发生。

en.t: Yet troubling things can also arise suddenly.

units.source_text: 他觉得胸中充满了热恋，然而努力镇静，神气十足地说道：“父亲有话命我转达，叮嘱我勿使外人听到。

en.t: He felt his breast filled with burning love, but forced himself to remain calm and said with great dignity, "My father has ordered me to deliver a message, and he warned me not to let outsiders hear it.

units.source_text: 现在我可以说么？”

en.t: May I say it now?"

units.source_text: 玉鬘身边的侍女一听此言，便稍稍退避，躲到了帷屏后面等处。

en.t: When the waiting women beside Tamakazura heard this, they withdrew a little and hid themselves behind the screens and elsewhere.

units.source_text: 夕雾就捏造出一番话来，冒充源氏太政大臣的口吻，煞有介事地详细转达了。

en.t: Yugiri then invented a speech, assuming the tone of Genji the Grand Minister, and relayed it in solemn and elaborate detail.

units.source_text: 大意是：皇上对她另眼看待，叫她心中早做准备。

en.t: The gist was that the Emperor regarded her differently from others, and that she should prepare her heart in advance.

units.source_text: 玉鬘默默不答，只是悄悄地叹息。

en.t: Tamakazura remained silent and gave no answer, only sighing softly to herself.

units.source_text: 夕雾觉得这态度可亲可爱，越发忍耐不住了，对她说道：“丧服在本月内期满。

en.t: Yugiri found this manner of hers dear and lovable, and, unable to endure his feelings any longer, said to her, "The term of mourning will end within this month.

units.source_text: 父亲说另外没有好日子，决定在十三日到河原去举行除服祓禊。

en.t: My father says there is no other auspicious day, so it has been decided that on the thirteenth we will go to the riverbank to perform the purification for removing mourning clothes.

units.source_text: 那时我也当奉陪前往。”

en.t: At that time I too shall accompany you."

units.source_text: 玉鬘答道：“你也同去，生怕太招摇了。

en.t: Tamakazura answered, "If you go with us too, I fear it will attract too much attention.

units.source_text: 还是大家悄悄地前往为是。”

en.t: It would be better for everyone to go quietly."

units.source_text: 她的意思是勿使外人详细知道她穿丧服的理由，其用心实甚周到。

en.t: What she meant was that outsiders should not learn in detail why she was wearing mourning, and her thoughtfulness was truly careful.

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“你不欲向人泄露实情，太对不起太君了。

en.t: Yugiri said, "Your wish not to reveal the truth to others is terribly unfair to the old lady.

units.source_text: 我觉得这丧服是我所思慕难忘的外祖母的遗念，舍不得脱掉它呢。

en.t: To me, these mourning clothes seem a keepsake of the grandmother I long for and cannot forget, and I cannot bear to take them off.

units.source_text: 再则：我们两家关系何以如此密切，我实在想不通。

en.t: Besides, I truly cannot understand why the relationship between our two families should be so close.

units.source_text: 如果你不穿这表示血统关系的丧服，我还不相信你是太君的孙女呢。”

en.t: If you were not wearing these mourning clothes that show your blood connection, I still would not believe that you were the old lady's granddaughter."

units.source_text: 玉鬘答道：“我什么也不懂得，何况这些事情，我更加弄不清楚。

en.t: Tamakazura answered, "I understand nothing at all, and when it comes to matters like these, I am even more at a loss.

units.source_text: 我只觉得这丧服的颜色异常可悲。”

en.t: I only feel that the color of these mourning clothes is unusually sorrowful."

units.source_text: 她的神情显得比平时颓丧，深可怜爱。

en.t: Her expression looked more downcast than usual, making her deeply pitiable and lovely.
